## Shipped (19)

| Capability | Summary | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **OAuth 2.0 device-flow sign-in**<br/><code>auth.device-flow</code> | Authenticate to a model provider with the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628), including the full section 3.5 error handling. | 2 test files |
| **PKCE on every token exchange**<br/><code>auth.pkce</code> | Every device-flow exchange carries an S256 PKCE challenge, binding it to the process that began the flow. | 1 test file |
| **OIDC endpoint discovery**<br/><code>auth.endpoint-discovery</code> | Device and token endpoints are read from the issuer's discovery document. No provider URL is hardcoded. | 1 test file |
| **Automatic token refresh**<br/><code>auth.token-refresh</code> | Tokens expiring within 60 seconds refresh before use. A refresh token the provider omits on refresh is retained rather than discarded. | 1 test file |
| **Credential storage in the OS credential store**<br/><code>auth.os-credential-store</code> | Tokens are held by Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain, or libsecret, with no native dependency. Where none is available an unencrypted file is used and reported as unprotected. | 1 test file |
| **Credentials are refused in project files**<br/><code>auth.no-credentials-in-project-files</code> | `config set llm.apiKey` refuses. A test asserts no token reaches the provider configuration file. | 1 test file |
| **Studio sign-in without exposing credentials to the browser**<br/><code>auth.studio-routes</code> | The browser receives only the user code and verification URI. Device code, access token, and refresh token stay in the local server process. | 1 test file |
| **Transactional SQLite store**<br/><code>store.sqlite-transactions</code> | Immediate transactions, foreign keys, WAL, numbered migrations, and pre-migration backups. | 1 test file |
| **Migration failure rolls back**<br/><code>store.migration-rollback</code> | An injected mid-migration failure leaves the database recoverable. | 1 test file |
| **Fair-play mystery rule pack**<br/><code>packs.fair-play-mystery</code> | 22 deterministic rules across 10 validation suites, with a sealed-solution capability boundary and a reader projection. | 1 test file |
| **Reader projection excludes sealed content**<br/><code>packs.reader-projection</code> | A reader-facing projection cannot leak culprit identity or true evidence meaning. | 1 test file |
| **Advisory English prose-pattern inspection**<br/><code>packs.prose-patterns</code> | Reports phrases and structural tendencies for human review. Never infers authorship and never rewrites prose. | 1 test file |
| **Durable workflow topology**<br/><code>workflow.durable-topology</code> | Node dependencies, capability requirements, budgets, cancellation, and resumable failures persist. Execution is supplied by the caller. | 1 test file |
| **Local Studio server bound to loopback**<br/><code>studio.local-server</code> |  | 1 test file |
| **Fixture-backed public demonstration**<br/><code>studio.fixture-demo</code> | Immutable demo data. Accepts no credentials, makes no model call, and never receives a manuscript. | 1 test file |
| **CLI command surface**<br/><code>cli.commands</code> | init, auth, config, doctor, inspect-prose, studio | 1 test file |
| **Opt-in allowlisted diagnostics**<br/><code>telemetry.opt-in</code> | Off by default. Rejects manuscript text, prompts, responses, project names, paths, and graph content. | 1 test file |
| **Validated development-agent task loop**<br/><code>dev-agent.task-loop</code> | Scoped task state records the discover, orient, plan, implement, verify, document, review, and handoff loop with validation and evidence fields. | 1 test file |
| **Hermes Agent environment diagnostics**<br/><code>dev-agent.hermes-doctor</code> | Reports Hermes availability, version, repository context files, generated task context, memory location, and available sandbox metadata without pretending Hermes executed when it is unavailable. | 1 test file |
